decision: Approve only the existing Client Workspace Worker/D1 collaboration rollout after remaining live acceptance; no Pages changes, new resources, persistent publishing credentials, production publication or team notification

application.activationFlag: COLLABORATION_ENABLED=true only after approved migration and acceptance

persistence.publicationStorage: Atomic revision-checked project aggregate; immutable per-job snapshot and current publication pointer commit with actor/reviewer/requester membership predicates

preview.mechanism: Authenticated Client Workspace renderer reads a reviewed snapshot from existing D1; no Pages requests, bindings, branch deployments or alias changes
preview.sourceBaseline: Checked-in seed content, not a claim of current live KV equivalence
preview.scope: Home hero headline component; inert renderer with source/content evidence, not a full live site clone
preview.sourcePromotion: Download exact expected/proposed source values and immutable base commit for a separate reviewed source change; production remains Micah-only

identity.publicMetadataVerified: restricted enrollment, mailbox proof required, 900-second proof TTL
identity.enrollmentMethod: Issue three exact-email admission records using the existing enrollment invitations API; no email is sent by issuance
identity.activation: Verify live ENROLLMENT_INVITATIONS_ENABLED and enable only that reviewed invitation mode if disabled; never enable public enrollment or replace unrelated allowlists
identity.userFlow: After preview acceptance and separate notification authorization, each person self-starts /v1/auth/enrollment/start and completes mailbox proof at /v1/auth/enrollment/complete, then signs into Client Workspace

credentialPlan.identityAdmission: Use existing authorized Identity service deputy with enrollment_invitation_manage. If none exists, approve one narrow deputy through the existing secure secret manager; revoke after admissions. Never expose it to the client or model.
credentialPlan.agent: Browser generates a 256-bit random application task token; authenticated owner registers only its SHA-256 hash. Copy to the chosen agent through native secure MCP configuration. Exact MCP resource audience, one task/proposal, expiry at the earlier of task deadline or current human token expiry (maximum 15 minutes); owner membership revocation enforced. Only context read/proposal create; no human/provider token handoff. Stored only in browser memory and agent secure configuration, never D1 plaintext.
credentialPlan.git: None for preview publication. No GitHub write grant or workflow token. Source proposal export is read-only; any later source promotion uses the existing reviewed repository process.
credentialPlan.pages: None. No Pages Edit token, Pages API or Pages deployment workflow is required.
credentialPlan.runtimeStorage: Existing Worker DB binding only. No KV, R2, REST API token or new storage binding for collaboration.
credentialPlan.provisioning: Use Micah's existing operator session only for the approved named resource/binding/migration changes; do not copy it into runtime or CI. Credential values stay in native secure setup, never chat, source, logs or screenshots.

acceptanceBeforeTeamNotification: Source review, required checks and approved existing Worker deployment process pass without bypass
Exact roster + Micah can enter collaboration routes; team cannot enter existing operator workspace or other tenants
Actual Claude/Codex native MCP task connection creates one proposal using existing authorized provider session without API billing fallback
Human approval and publication produce one atomic D1 snapshot; immutable job URL renders exact content and provides source proposal export
Lost-response replay, stale/concurrent jobs, membership revocation and source bundle changes fail safely
Existing maverick-x production/preview bindings and aliases are untouched; no publishing token exists
Live sign-in, restricted admissions, refresh and authorized browser round trip work before separately authorized notifications
notIncluded: general workspace access for the roster
new model API key or paid model run
architecture: Worker-hosted reviewed component snapshots; source Git remains authoritative and unchanged until separately reviewed promotion

costs.usage: Existing Worker requests and D1 reads/writes/storage consume account quotas and may incur charges; no fixed-dollar estimate or platform spending cap is established
costs.bounds: 200 project mutations, 512000-byte aggregate, 16KiB incoming requests, one proposal per task, maximum 15-minute task grant, no polling/alarms/SSE keepalive/automatic provider jobs
costs.modelBilling: No new model key, API billing fallback or paid run; actual provider acceptance remains gated

rolloutApproval.approved: Normal reviewed source promotion, CI, existing Worker deployment, two D1 tables and mailbox-verified enrollment for the three exact teammates
rolloutApproval.excluded: New deputy/credential, broader access, website production promotion, pilot availability claim before live acceptance
